instructions.question: What overall sentiment, even if mild, does the tweet's author express or convey about its topic: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Mild feelings count. Any complaint, disappointment, criticism, sarcasm or bad news (injuries, losses, scandals, attacks) is negative. Any interest, enjoyment, looking forward to a fun event, praise, good news or tribute is positive. Neutral is only for tweets with no evaluative tilt: plain facts, schedules, ads without praise, questions, or a balanced mix.

neutral.what: Purely informational or logistical tweets, questions, ads and listings without evaluative words, or tweets with a balanced mix of feelings.
examples: Selling a ticket for Twilight Sad at the Barrowlands this Saturday (Face value)
NEWS: Kerry says US may set up refugee camp structures to help with Syria crisis
Kanye West is insane. He also may be a complete genius. But I still don't want him to be president. #VMAs #fb
neutral.cues: headlines, may, will be, selling, register, who is going, schedules, scores
neutral.not_for: News of injuries, deaths, scandals or losses (negative); news of wins or awards (positive).

positive.what: Enjoyment, excitement, interest, praise, hope, gratitude, tributes, or good news for someone the author favours, including fun plans and upbeat promotion.
examples: Can't wait to see you tomorrow at The Roxy!
I just saw a glance at the new Galaxy Note 5. Looks interesting. That may be my next phone.
Surprising my mom with AC/DC tickets for Wednesday. Just going to show up
positive.cues: can't wait, love, interesting, good, fun, hopefully, finally, celebrating, special, !!, ;)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic praise (negative); plain ads, schedules or 'who wants to come' questions (neutral).

negative.what: Anger, insults, sadness, frustration, disappointment, criticism, mockery or sarcasm, and bad news such as injuries, charges, attacks and losses.
examples: still so sad I'm not going to Ed Sheeran the 25th :////
A really unimpressive 1st half of football at Wembley (then again what do you expect.) can see Kane coming on early on. #ENGvSWI #England
Gavin Henson looks set to miss the Rugby World Cup after dislocating a bone in his right wrist yesterday
negative.cues: sad, bummed, hate, worst, stupid, bad, tedious, unimpressive, frustrating, wtf, killed, injured, :(
negative.not_for: Factual reports with no harm or criticism (neutral).
